title: Eval harness and corpus live in the scanner project
description:
As an eval author, I want tests/eval, the benchmark corpus, and Plexus-facing scanner recall next to the engine, so that we score the library, not the CLI wrapper.

Feature: eval follows the engine

  Scenario: T1 mention grade runs in the scanner project
    Given the proposed mention gold
    When I run the mention-layer eval from the scanner project
    Then I get the same scoring contract as today's T1

  Scenario: Four-layer work follows
    Given KDATAP-0dbc61
    Then new eval layers are added in the scanner project
